input_url.description: file:// URL or absolute path. For convert jobs, this is the package_url from the prep job.

archive_identifier.description: Internet Archive item identifier. When present on a prep job, the worker fetches the item's ABBYY XML derivative (sha1-verified against the manifest and the input PDF) and annotates the word-level declaration with the recognizing engine's own per-word confidence and flags (#81 phase 1).
